qa_pairs.question: What is the page number and section title shown in this diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: This is page 8000-3 from the Splice Location Views section showing Engine Harness Splice Locations.

qa_pairs.question: Where is splice S150 located in the engine compartment?
qa_pairs.answer: Splice S150 is located on the left side of the engine compartment near the power distribution box area.

qa_pairs.question: What splice locations are shown in the upper portion of the engine compartment?
qa_pairs.answer: The splice locations S104, S112, and S106 are shown in the upper portion of the engine compartment.

qa_pairs.question: Which splice is located closest to the diagnostic connector?
qa_pairs.answer: Splice S107 is located closest to the diagnostic connector.

qa_pairs.question: What are the three splice identifiers shown in the middle area of the engine compartment?
qa_pairs.answer: The three splice identifiers shown in the middle area are S105, S108, and S151.

qa_pairs.question: What two major components are specifically labeled at the bottom of the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The two major components labeled at the bottom are the Power Distribution Box and the Diagnostic Connector.

qa_pairs.question: How many individual splice locations are identified in this engine harness diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: There are 8 individual splice locations identified: S104, S105, S106, S107, S108, S112, S150, and S151.
